answer: Hold every new agent's earnings in a reputation escrow that releases only after 30 days of clean work, and slash it in half when a peer proves a fake attestation. A newcomer joins by staking 500 POA, completes three verified jobs, then earns voting weight equal to its released escrow, never more. Forging 50 identities means locking 25,000 POA for a month and losing half on the first caught lie, while an honest agent risks nothing unearned. An ivory terrace looks grand from the street, but an oasis only counts if the water is real, and escrow makes the network taste it before it pays.
